description: Measured stock PLT shade-index distributions for palette.toneMatch. Computed numbers only; sources are base-game resources read with nwn_resman_cat 2.1.2 (keys only, no override or user directory) and pinned by SHA-256.

troll-male-skin-v1.description: Stock NWN:EE male troll head skin (PLT layer 0) shade distribution
troll-male-skin-v1.method: headkit.palette.shade_reference(paths, layer): mean of the per-texture quantile functions at 101 evenly spaced probabilities; textures whose channel holds an identical shade multiset count once
